products.title: Columbia Men's Facet 75 Mid Outdry Hiking Shoe
products.description: Set yourself in motion with this technical waterproof hiker. It offers elevated comfort, protection, and versatility, with responsive Techlite Plush cushioning, a Navic Fit secure lacing system, and a gripping outsole to tackle multiple terrains. Built with our OutDry waterproof membrane with seamless, breathable construction, these hikers add a TPU heel clip and mid foot support for stability. The outsole is fitted with burly 5mm lug traction that’s specifically designed for hiking. Columbia offers these men’s mid hiking shoes in multiple colors and sizes.

products.title: ASICS Women's Gel-Fujitrabuco 6
products.description: A long-time favorite of off-road runners, our newly updated, lighter-weight GEL-Fuji Trabuco 6 is ready to hit the trails. GEL-Fuji Trabuco 6 has made its name with a winning blend of cushioning, responsiveness and versatile traction. Get up to speed with a trail-specific outsole, Rear foot GEL Cushioning Technology and protective toe bumper for the roughest ground. An Ortholite sock liner provides immediate step-in comfort, while a lace garage and gusseted tongue ensure a secure, debris-free fit. Enhanced performance is built in throughout the shoe, while a more rugged mesh provides added durability. GEL-Fuji Trabuco 6 is a shoe warrior that not only beckons you to go off road, but equips you for success.

products.title: Salomon Women's X-Ultra Shoe
products.description: Lightweight, yet durable, the X-Ultra is ready for fast hiking through mixed terrain. Salomon was born in 1947 in the heart of the French Alps and the birthplace of modern alpinism. Driven by a passion for skiing and design innovation, Francois Salomon and his son George designed and perfected much of the first modern ski equipment. During the following 60 years, Salomon's commitment to innovative design and passion for mountain sports created a vast range of revolutionary new concepts in boots, skis and apparel and brought innovative solutions to footwear, apparel and equipment for hiking, adventure racing, mountaineering and trail running. Through performance-driven design, Salomon enhances mountain sports by converting new ideas into action and expanding the limits of possibility.

products.title: KEEN Men's Tempo Flex Low Height Lightweight Waterproof Hiking Shoe
products.description: When you want to hike light and fast, the less resistance the better. That’s where flex can help. So we took our proven hybrid hiker-sneaker platform and added KEEN.BELLOWS FLEX at key flex points. For a men’s waterproof hiking sneaker that flexes where you do. Made with durable, mesh and featuring a moisture-wicking lining, the KEEN Men’s Tempo Flex Low Height Lightweight Waterproof Hiking Shoe is built off KEEN's traditional wider footwear form. KEEN products are consciously created using a natural, pesticide-free probiotic-based technology called Eco Anti-Odor for breaking down odor in sweat, PFC-free water repellent (in applicable styles) and leather sourced from Leather Working Group (LWG)-certified tanneries. KEEN makes shoes to make a difference. From the products it makes, to the actions the it takes, KEEN inspires people to live and work monumental every day. As a brand born for life outside, KEEN has a responsibility to protect and conserve the places where all people live, play and work.

products.title: WOLVERINE Women's I-90 Epx Romeo Construction Boot
products.description: Named after the longest highway in the United States, the Wolverine I-90 is made for long hours and many miles. The I-90 features a highly abrasion resistant TPU outsole which lasts 3x longer than other boots, and is resistant to splitting, chemicals and oils.
